items.desc: There is an active volcano in this region, spewing forth lava and volcanic gases.

items.name: £blocker£ Dangerous Wildlife
items.desc: The wildlife in this region is particularly lethal, with many dangerous predators and poisonous plants.

items.name: £blocker£ Lethal Ecosphere
items.desc: Specimens and experiments discarded by the War fragment constantly vie for survival in bloody unnatural selection. These incredibly hostile training grounds are sure to prove lethal for most soldiers but survivors would undoubtedly come out of this as relentless killing machines.

items.name: £blocker£ Dense Jungle
items.desc: This entire region is completely overgrown with thick, impassable jungle.

items.name: £blocker£ Toxic Kelp
items.desc: A thick forest of kelp that is toxic to most forms of life covers the ocean in this region.

items.name: £blocker£ Deep Sinkhole
items.desc: A colossal sinkhole covers most of this region.
items.on_cleared: planetscaper_pop_effect = yes

items.name: £blocker£ Quicksand Basin
items.desc: A vast body of quicksand covers this region, making construction impossible.
items.on_cleared: planetscaper_pop_effect = yes

items.name: £blocker£ Noxious Swamp
items.desc: Treacherous swamplands and bogs surrounded by putrid gases.

items.name: £blocker£ Massive Glacier
items.desc: An immense body of dense ice covers this region.
items.on_cleared: planetscaper_pop_effect = yes

items.name: £blocker£ Radioactive Wasteland
items.desc: Few organisms can survive in this desolate, irradiated wasteland.

items.name: £blocker£ City Ruins
items.desc: Once a great city, now just a metal boneyard stretching as far as the eye can see.

items.name: £blocker£ Bomb Crater
items.desc: This massive crater was created by the detonation of a particularly devastating hydrogen bomb.

items.name: £blocker£ Impact Crater
items.desc: Something collided with the surface of this world at some point, creating this massive impact crater.

items.name: £blocker£ Ruined District
items.desc: This region is covered by countless craters caused by relentless Orbital Bombardment.

items.name: £blocker£ Wandering Forests
items.desc: The mobile forests of this world frequently migrate en masse to new regions, disrupting efforts at building roads, power lines and other infrastructure.

items.name: £blocker£ Subterranean Entrance
items.desc: A large hole in the ground that leads into the extensive cave network stretching beneath the surface of this world.

items.name: £blocker£ Titanic Lifeforms
items.desc: Numerous Titanic aliens make this area their home, it would be wise to avoid it.

items.name: £blocker£ Industrial Wasteland
items.desc: This region is covered by ruined industrial complexes and toxic soil; detritus from a past age of progress.

items.name: £blocker£ Sprawling Slums
items.desc: This region is covered by vast shanty towns and slums filled with the poor and the outcast.

items.name: £blocker£ Settled Ruins
items.desc: A scattered population of scavengers are eking out a desperate existence in the ruins of this once major city.

items.name: £blocker£ Radiation Zone
items.desc: A region that was the target of numerous nuclear warheads. Though the radiation in this area has gone down since the initial impact, it is still unfit for habitation barring a major clean-up effort.

items.name: £blocker£ Long-Abandoned City
items.desc: The crumbling remains of what must once have been a major population center on the planet. No traces of its past inhabitants remain.

items.name: £blocker£ Former Organic City
items.desc: The charred and irradiated ruins of what was once a major organic population center. Those buildings that still remain standing contain nothing but ashes now.

items.name: £blocker£ Battlefield Remnants
items.desc: Tens of thousands of burnt war machines and the twisted skeletal remains of organic soldiers litter the ground at this former battlefield. Residual pockets of radiation interferes with most electronics.

items.name: £blocker£ Abandoned Strip Mine
items.desc: This area was heavily strip mined in the past, by older and more primitive machine models that unfortunately were not programmed to take future development of the region into account.

items.name: £blocker£ Unsupervised Settlement
items.desc: A pocket of organic society on this world that still exists outside of machine supervision. Violence, disease and starvation run rampant inside the settlement's walls, whose inhabitants have regressed technologically by several centuries.

items.name: £blocker£ Collapsed Burrows
items.desc: This site once housed extensive underground tunnel systems inhabited by the Hive, but was abandoned due to overexploitation of local resources and wildlife.

items.name: £blocker£ Silent Ruins
items.desc: This once major settlement is now a crumbling ruin, occupied only by the decaying bodies of those organics that chose self-termination rather than be assimilated.

items.name: £blocker£ Fungoid Extermination Residue
items.desc: This toxic goo is all that remains of the exterminated Fungoids.

items.name: Rifts
items.desc: Seismological phenomena are causing the planet crust to crack, spewing out sulfuric gases and toxic slime.

items.name: £blocker£ Ruins
items.desc: Extensive ruins block all access.

items.name: £blocker£ Ruined Arcology
items.desc: The Arcologies which cover this City-Planet lie in ruins. While the foundations are still solid, much of the decaying structure will need to be cleared before we can rebuild.

items.name: £blocker£ Archaeological Site
items.desc: This area contains ancient archaeological finds that are being excavated.
items.can_be_cleared: always = no

items.name: £blocker£ Lithoid Monoliths
items.desc: Incredibly rich outcroppings of minerals that seem to be comprised of petrified lithoids.

items.name: £blocker£ Lithoid Devastation
items.desc: A lithoid devouring swarm has despoiled this region. With great effort it may be possible to undo the damage.

items.name: £blocker£ Terraforming Residue
items.desc: The results of a partially successful terraforming project have created areas of strange biological abominations.

items.name: £blocker£ Exhausted Deposit
items.desc: This area has been completely stripped of its natural resources, and is now reduced to a wasteland.

items.name: £blocker£ Tainted Snowcaps
items.desc: The last toxic remains of the once enormous mountains of poison that dominated this world.

items.name: £blocker£ Poisonous Algae
items.desc: This noxious algae survived the initial cleansing of this world. While it is not aggressive enough to prevent colonization, it has proven highly adaptable... and quite simply a nuisance.

items.name: £blocker£ Venomous Insects
items.desc: The lost broods of venomous vermin that we had hoped to extinguish during the early days of our terraforming effort.

items.name: £blocker£ Unpleasant Atmosphere
items.desc: The disgusting taste and smell of the air are what remains of this planet's toxic past.

items.name: £blocker£ Rotten Soil
items.desc: Even this rotten soil will be useful to us, once it has been refreshed and reinvigorated.

items.name: Mass Graves
items.desc: After a cataclysmic plague decimated the global population, all that remains is a silent expanse that stretches towards the horizon. An empty landscape, occupied by countless lost souls.

items.name: £blocker£ Explosive Fungal Growth
items.desc: This region of the planet has been infested by a constantly growing forest of alien fungi.

items.name: £blocker£ Explosive Sylvan Growth
items.desc: This region of the planet has been infested by a constantly growing forest of alien flora.

items.name: Spreading Landfill
items.desc: Endless hills of trash, rapidly sprawling out of their designated zones.

items.name: £blocker£ Nanite Harvest Basin
items.desc: This site marks the remnants of resources harvested to spawn new nanites, a scar left behind by the relentless extraction stripping this planet.

items.name: £blocker£ Ruined Hatchery
items.desc: This automated industrial complex employed self-sustaining power generation to continuously produce biological machines.

items.name: Machine Hulk
items.desc: The slagged hulk of a once-sapient Machine remains on this world, looming like a vast headstone.

items.name: Fungal Caves
items.desc: These extensive cave networks are covered in many species of edible fungi, which require neither sunlight nor fertile soil to flourish.

items.name: Lush Jungle
items.desc: With a dense canopy and nigh-impenetrable vegetation density, these jungles are poor in soil quality, but rich in plant life and fruit-bearing trees.

items.name: Fertile Lands
items.desc: This vast stretch of open plains provides ideal farmland.

items.name: Great River
items.desc: A slow-flowing river of enormous volume provides water and vegetation for a rich abundance of life.

items.name: Black Soil
items.desc: With a remarkably high moisture capacity and high amounts of chemicals integral to plant life, these soils promise impressive agricultural yields.

items.name: Teeming Reef
items.desc: A vibrant ecosystem brimming with corals, fish, mollusks, mammals, invertebrates, and all kinds of edible marine life.

items.name: Marvelous Oasis
items.desc: A shimmering jewel of water and greenery in a barren wasteland.

items.name: Tropical Island
items.desc: From fruit-laden trees to plentiful fauna, the bounties of this paradisaical island promise a rich harvest.

items.name: Fungal Forest
items.desc: In lieu of trees, towering mushrooms dominate these fecund forests, the enormous caps of fungal giants blotting out sunlight to create the perfect environment for a rich variety of smaller specimens.

items.name: Dust Caverns
items.desc: Rare Volatile Motes condense in these sandy caves and hidden hollows.

items.name: Dust Desert
items.desc: A vast expanse of sand that covers scattered pockets of rare and valuable Volatile Motes. Extraction is possible with the right equipment.

items.name: Bubbling Swamp
items.desc: A hotbed of aquatic plants, insects, and swamp gas, this wetland is characterized by slow-moving water and rich vegetation.

items.name: Fuming Bog
items.desc: A noxious quagmire covered in low vegetation, mosses and fungi, where gases steam from the water's surface.

items.name: Crystalline Caverns
items.desc: Like enormous geodes, these caves are filled on all sides with rare crystals.

items.name: Crystal Forest
items.desc: Glittering crystals grow like hoarfrost in these exotic forests.

items.name: Crystal Reef
items.desc: Crystal lattices glimmer amongst the rocks and corals of this sandy reef.

items.name: Betharian Fields
items.desc: Thousands upon thousands of valuable Betharian stones glint like stars in these fields.

items.name: Isolated Valley
items.desc: This pristine valley lies sheltered amongst the surrounding mountains, its fauna shielded from roving predators.

items.name: Buzzing Plains
items.desc: These windy plains crackle with static electricity.

items.name: Mineral Striations
items.desc: Shallow faults have brought rich mineral veins to the surface.

items.name: Natural Farmland
items.desc: These plains are naturally subdivided into alarmingly regular geometric shapes, ready for agricultural exploitation.

items.name: Metal Boneyards
items.desc: The hollowed-out metal skeletons of fallen infrastructure seem almost to groan as the wind whistles through them.

items.name: Migrating Forests
items.desc: The mobile forests of this world frequently migrate en masse to new regions, disrupting efforts at building roads, power lines and other infrastructure.

items.name: Migrating Forest Reserve
items.desc: This entire region has been set aside for the migrating forests that are native to this world. Here they can roam in peace, without causing damage to urban areas.

items.name: Junk Wastes
items.desc: The wastes stretch as far as one can see, with occasional pieces of larger junk jutting up out of the ground.

items.name: Junk Canals
items.desc: These narrow canals snake around the junk piles, and some of the adjacent soil is surprisingly fertile.

items.name: Junk Hollows
items.desc: These hollows deep beneath the surface junk would serve well as isolated reactor chambers.

items.name: Irradiated Valley
items.desc: A solar flare has washed this isolated valley with heavy radiation.

items.name: Valley of Zanaam
items.desc: This valley is home to a mysterious obelisk that is covered in letters from a dead alien language. It hums with power and those in its proximity suffer headaches.

items.name: Abandoned Homesteads
items.desc: These abandoned homesteads were once inhabited by a society of reptiles. They still populate the planet, but have since lost all capacity for sapient though.

items.name: Zone A
items.desc: A thirteen-by-thirteen kilometer stretch of land on this planet is a ruin of unknown origin, littered with many bizarre and unique alien artifacts. Bafflingly, it also produces sensations of deep contentment in its visitors.

items.name: Hyperfertile Valley
items.desc: The soil in this valley is extremely fertile, and it is covered in intense greenery.

items.name: Ancient Mining Site
items.desc: The site of an ancient mining operation. Despite its age, much of the equipment can still be operated.

items.name: Toy Factory Complex
items.desc: Complex machinery ceaselessly molds complex polymers into small items of varying shapes and inscrutable purpose.

items.name: Mutant Landfill
items.desc: A putrid mass of dead mutated horrors. Their volatile organic matter has twisted together to form a structure of sorts.

items.name: Ancient Bombardment Craters
items.desc: This world was subjected to intense orbital bombardment long ago. Parts of the surface are still pockmarked with impact craters.

items.name: Ancient Battlefield
items.desc: The civilization that once inhabited this world was destroyed by an invading force from somewhere beyond their solar system. This ancient battlefield is littered with ancient debris from their desperate last stand.

items.name: Irradiated Ruins
items.desc: Remnants from a massive nuclear war waged by the two global superpowers that once inhabited this world.

items.name: Impact Crater
items.desc: A crater from a large meteor impact. Minerals from the meteor itself can still be found at the site.

items.name: Odd Factory
items.desc: A well-crafted facility that produces high value resources, left on the planet by a different civilization.

items.name: Ancient Particle Accelerator
items.desc: This old particle accelerator was built using a novel design, and the surviving terminals within the structure contain a massive amount of research data composed by what must have been a brilliant theoretical physicist.

items.name: Underground Vault
items.desc: A massive underground vault, intended as a bomb shelter by this world's original inhabitants. The vault's occupants turned on each other when their food ran out.

items.name: Underground Vault
items.desc: A massive underground vault, intended as a bomb shelter by this world's original inhabitants. The vault contains a huge machine park along with stores of mining equipment.

items.name: Cryonic Clones Monument
items.desc: Hundreds of alien clones were left sealed in cryostasis chambers when this Ring World was still a ruin. Now fully restored, the clones have been preserved in this monument.

items.name: Flooded Mounds
items.desc: Thousands upon thousands of interconnected termite-like mounds can be found far beneath the ocean on this world, the last remnants of an ancient species of sapient arthropoids.

items.name: Processing Pens
items.desc: The fungoids native to this planet were genetically engineered to be docile... and delicious. In these vast processing pens, the fungoids are nourished and then harvested.

items.name: Harvester Fields
items.desc: Vast fields of dense, edible vegetation where ancient solar-powered harvesters assist in gathering crops.

items.name: Wetware Computer
items.desc: The oceans on this world are almost completely covered in a fine network of algae that appear to be a primitive wetware computer.

items.name: Savage Wildlands
items.desc: The indigenous creatures who inhabit this region appear to operate as a single organism.

items.name: £blocker£ Mothballed Facilities
items.desc: Districts and buildings finished to the latest colonial standard, but obviously left in disuse and partial disrepair for years.

items.name: Loop-Plowed Farm
items.desc: The food crops lean into the wind, somehow.

items.name: Organic Landfills
items.desc: Toxic biohazard waste rots and fumes in vast heaps under the sun.

items.name: Subterranean Farming Caverns
items.desc: A network of vast caverns which contain numerous fungal farms, hunting areas, and lakes teeming with edible flora and fauna.

items.name: Subterranean Mining Sites
items.desc: Underground tunnels lead to a variety of mineral-rich ore veins inaccessible from the surface.

items.name: Subterranean Generator Areas
items.desc: Subterranean rivers and the geothermal energy from the molten core of the planet offer vast potential for energy generation.

items.name: Teeming Farming Caverns
items.desc: These Subterranean areas are currently fully exploited by the Civilization living there.

items.name: £blocker£ Corpse-Filled Caverns
items.desc: Vast numbers of dead Subterraneans need to be removed before we can make use of these areas.

items.name: £blocker£ Corpse-Filled Mining Sites

items.name: £blocker£ Corpse-Filled Generator Areas

items.name: Subterranean Contact Zone
items.desc: An area where Subterranean dwellers and Surfacers can work together towards peace and prosperity.

items.name: Space-Time Anomaly
items.desc: A remarkably stable space-time anomaly left behind by an extradimensional species which conducted research on the planet. The scientific implications of its existence are, apparently, quite profound.

items.name: Portal Research Area
items.desc: A secure complex has been built around the Dimensional Portal to house research staff dedicated to probing its mysteries.

items.name: Ancient One
items.desc: An ancient being, living deep beneath the waves, is the dominating life force on this planet.

items.name: Numa's Breath
items.desc: This stable vent reaching into the planet's crust was created by The Numistic Order.

items.name: Nanosands
items.desc: The sand dunes on this planet are almost entirely composed of countless broken nanites. Their structure is degraded far beyond any chance for reactivation, but they do coat the planet in rare metal granulate.

items.name: Sentinels
items.desc: The Sentinels guard this land; it may not be disturbed. The Sentinels counts as Defense Armies, and will come to the planet's aid if there's an invasion.

items.name: Sentinels
items.desc: The broken remains of nine monumental automatons made from an unusual metal alloy offer an ample supply of §HLiving Metal§!.

items.name: The Sentinels
items.desc: Ancient guardians watch over the planet inspiring unity and spirituality in our people.

items.name: Enigmatic Robot
items.desc: An ancient and enigmatic little robot, supervising a factory which dates back to an earlier civilization.

items.name: Enigmatic Robot
items.desc: An ancient and enigmatic little robot, supervising a factory which dates back to an earlier civilization.

items.name: Enigmatic Robot
items.desc: An ancient and enigmatic little robot, supervising a factory which dates back to an earlier civilization.

items.name: Juvenile Nemma
items.desc: A young Nemma which we have bred and is now large enough to be capable of carrying some of our industry.

items.name: Nemma Mining Operation
items.desc: The careful balance of drugs and pain inhibitors allows us to drill into the Nemmas while still residing on them.

items.name: Nemma Corpses
items.desc: The floating remains of the gargantuan Nemma that once lived here can still be seen from orbit. The reptilian amphibian is now naught but a floating island.

items.name: Ancient Sunken City
items.desc: The cities of the Polarians once covered the frozen ocean before their icy foundations melted away.

items.name: Nanite Swarm Remains
items.desc: A fine powder is all that remains of the massive nanite swarm that evolved on - and once covered - Parvus III.

items.name: Fungal Study Zone
items.desc: The 'spying' mushrooms found here are an endless source of cryptic insights into their strange biology, and how they connect to one another.

items.name: Feeding Dragon
items.desc: The mighty Sky Dragon has landed, and is proceeding to devour its way through a startling amount of food.

items.name: Living Snow Reserve
items.desc: A reservation where the Living Snow can live in peace and explore its new state of being. And where, in turn, we can observe the unique chemical reactions it is able to produce.

items.name: Dayside Solar Farm
items.desc: This world has all its solar power set up on the dayside of its tidally locked hemispheres, granting it access to unlimited solar hours.

items.name: Radiotrophic Preserve
items.desc: An isolated area filled with low pressure and a very radioactive atmosphere keeps the natives of this world alive.

items.name: Organic-Machine Interface Center
items.desc: A specialized center where malfunctioning drones are paired with biological assistants.

items.name: Crystalline Remains
items.desc: The broken remains of the crystalline entity that dwelled under the crust of this world. Its many tentacles all turned into rich mineral veins.

items.name: Shattered Crystalline Remains
items.desc: The broken remains of the crystalline entity that dwelled under the crust of this world. Its many tentacles all turned into rich mineral veins.

items.name: Nature Preserve
items.desc: A section of this world has been declared a nature preserve and may never be tampered with.

items.name: Shroud-Touched Region
items.desc: Forever scarred by the Shroud.

items.name: Semi-Shrouded Region
items.desc: Bordering the Shroud-Touched regions, unique flora and fauna have emerged, each with properties that are absent from existing datasets.

items.name: Dimensional Manipulation Device
items.desc: A device stolen from the fae Syamelle, it can manipulate the very dimensions and render what appears small to be more spacious.

items.name: A Blight Upon the Land
items.desc: It is said that in this place, the Deity first smote the land in anger. Little remains of what once was here.

items.name: Blighted Remembrance
items.desc: It is said that in this place, the Deity first smote the land in anger. Little remains of what once was here, but a monument has been erected, its features synthesized from our memories of that moment.

items.name: Swarms of the Deity
items.desc: In the Deity's wake, insects previously unknown to this world spread rapidly, coming to thrive in many of the affected areas. Their pestilent presence continues to test us as we seek to cultivate these lands.

items.name: Subdued Swarms
items.desc: In the Deity's wake, insects previously unknown to this world spread rapidly, coming to thrive in many of the affected areas. We have mastered the art of farming them for their succulent taste and potent venom.

items.name: Pools Most Venemous
items.desc: Left in the Deity's wake are many pools most venemous, from which remnants of Its toxins may be recovered.

items.name: Toxins Most Deadly
items.desc: Left in the Deity's wake are many pools most venomous, from which remnants of Its toxins may be recovered. Thanks to the efforts of the Knights of the Toxic God, we are now able to harvest and make diverse use of this potent poison.

items.name: Pestilential Wasteland
items.desc: Not all could enjoy the blessings of the Deity. Large areas of land were ruined by its passing, never to recover.

items.name: Reclaimed Pestilence
items.desc: Not all could enjoy the blessings of the Deity. Large areas of land were ruined by its passing, never to recover. However, the suits of armor recovered by the knights have provided us with the means to work safely in these parts.

items.name: Envenomed Seas
items.desc: Not even the seas were spared the Deity's baneful touch.

items.name: Pelagic Bounty
items.desc: Our Knights have brought back the technology necessary to harvest exotic gases from the seas touched by the Toxic God.

items.name: Order's X-Calibrator
items.desc: The Order's most revered relic, sustaining the entire Keep.

items.name: Operational Manufactorium
items.desc: An alien Manufactorium, fully operational and producing precious resources for the empire.

items.name: Manufactorium Scrapyard
items.desc: Specialized salvaging yards are dismantling the old machinery and turning the scraps into useful materials.

items.name: Destroyed Vault
items.desc: All that remains of the vault is a crater filled with machinery and debris. Although most of it is now useless, it provides easy access to recyclable materials.

items.name: Mountainous Vault
items.desc: This large underground complex is currently being explored by dedicated research units, putting strain on the planetary power grid.

items.name: Metallic Puddles
items.desc: Rare meteorology allows Puddle Technicians to harvest food and alloys simultaneously.

items.name: Empty Quarry
items.desc: The last geode was extracted from this quarry a long time ago.

items.name: Shrouded Crater
items.desc: Part of this planet has been devoured by a §HShroud§! entity. The resulting crater is home to swirling purple mists, and those that venture nearby often never return.

items.name: Stasis Prison
items.desc: Inside this planet's moon, an abandoned prison complex is connected to a network of highly advanced stasis pods. Prisoners frozen within are unable to escape.

items.name: Structured Integration
items.desc: Freeing the stasis prisoners all at once would have been a mistake. By examining them on a case by case basis, we can better ensure that each individual can fully integrate into our society.

items.name: Meals in Pods
items.desc: Those frozen in stasis make for excellent pre-packed meals.

items.name: Destroyed Promenade
items.desc: This enormous, multi-level hub once served as the station's central shopping area, but now only collapsed displays and garbage remain.

items.name: Promenade
items.desc: This enormous, multi-level hub serves as the station's central shopping area, with easy connections to commercial outlets, nutrition courts, and spas.

items.name: Abandoned Wing
items.desc: This section of the Star Mall lies in ruins. We must clear the decaying structure before we can rebuild.

items.name: Astrogarbage Unit
items.desc: By reducing the amount of orbital debris, this world hopes to maintain its spacefaring capabilities.

items.name: Myrmeku Power Farms
items.desc: These tiny insects generate power for us to harness.

items.name: Crystallized Ice Field
items.desc: These icy blue crystals were once the hearts of primordial glaciers.

items.name: Rich Seabed
items.desc: The seabed is littered with high-quality minerals.

items.name: Growing Floodplains
items.desc: Large areas of this world are flooded due to rapidly rising sea levels.

items.name: Red Desert
items.desc: Vast deserts stained red by the bloody sacrifices made here.

items.name: Invasive Fauna
items.desc: An invasive species of alien mammals.

items.name: Alien Safari
items.desc: A sanctuary built for alien fauna where tourists can interact with extraordinary species.

items.name: Strip Mine Network
items.desc: This planet has been stripped of most of the biosphere, enabling miners to extract significantly more resources.

items.name: Celestial Orrery Supercomputer
items.desc: The supercomputer that has kept the Celestial Orrery from gravitational collapse.

items.name: The Intelligence Mainframe
items.desc: Our ancestors' digital progeny blesses us with its aphorisms. Whether prophet or pet-project, it belongs to us now.

items.name: Scandinavian Reclamation Sector
items.desc: Reclamation efforts in the late 22nd century eliminated all but the most stubborn pockets of radiation, and mutation levels are now at an all-time low since the Containment Breach.

items.name: Pacific Algae Tracts
items.desc: Invisible until you plunge beneath the waves, the algae tracts seem to stretch into infinity.

items.name: Saharan Irrigation Project
items.desc: Few today remember the vicious ridicule that Operation Green Sahara faced when it was first proposed by Professor Izquierdo.

items.name: Mesopotamian Urban Corridor
items.desc: The megalopolis that stretches along most of the Fertile Crescent is in itself a monument to this ancient birthplace of civilization.

items.name: Delhi Sprawl
items.desc: Lakshmi Commerce Tower was the tallest building on Earth for the better part of the 22nd century, and its unique shape remains an iconic feature of the Delhi skyline.

items.name: BosWash Metropolitan Axis
items.desc: The BosWash Riots traumatized an entire generation and led to sweeping legal reforms. Never Forget!

items.name: Pearl River Agglomerate
items.desc: The first region on Earth to be officially designated a megacity. Several other developing urban regions would eventually adopt their own versions of the Golden Delta's successful anti-pollution policies.

items.name: Mauritanian Security Zone
items.desc: Unexploded munitions are still occasionally found near the compound where Colonel Tetchu and the remnants of his brigade made their famous last stand.

items.name: Great Albertan Crater
items.desc: When 711494 Satis approached Earth and triggered the Great Panic of '72, everyone thought this was it - the Big One had finally arrived. Fortunately, it wasn't big enough to cause an extinction event. Unfortunately, it wiped out much of Alberta.

items.name: £blocker£ Great Pacific Garbage Patch
items.desc: A swirling miasma of plastic refuse covers a good portion of Earth's largest ocean.

items.name: £blocker£ Industrial Wasteland
items.desc: This region is covered by ruined industrial complexes and toxic soil; detritus from a past age of progress.

items.name: Exotic Mountains
items.desc: Deep within these mountains lie vast reserves of exotic gases - the core of our biology.

items.name: £blocker£ Collapsed Spire
items.desc: An immense residential spire has collapsed under its own weight in this region, blocking access. While it was still standing, this towering structure must have been among the tallest on the planet.

items.name: £blocker£ Massive Crevice
items.desc: This region is divided by a vast crevice that cuts through what was once a dense urban zone. The ground here is extremely unstable, with frequent earthquakes and landslides.

items.name: £blocker£ Shattered Solar Array
items.desc: The shattered remnants of some kind of colossal solar array. When it was still functional, it must have provided power to a significant portion of this planet.

items.name: £blocker£ Flooded Reactor Pits
items.desc: These deep pits appear to have once housed the planet's main energy production facilities. Over the eons, rain and flooding have filled the pits with murky water.

items.name: £blocker£ Crumbling Mining Tunnels
items.desc: A network of deep tunnels beneath the planet's surface seem to have been its primary source of minerals. Millennia of cave-ins and rockfalls have left only a fraction of the tunnels traversable.

items.name: Ancient Reactor Pits
items.desc: These deep pits near the planet's equator once housed its primary energy generators. Much of the surprisingly sturdy infrastructure has survived, and new reactors can be slotted into it.

items.name: Immense Solar Array
items.desc: This solar array is nearly the size of a small continent. Most of it has been smashed beyond repair, but the underlying power infrastructure has survived, making it a good site for energy production.

items.name: Abandoned Mining Tunnels
items.desc: Many of the ruins on the planet's surface were built by minerals extracted from these tunnels. Although most have been mined to depletion, there are still several with rich yields.

items.name: Metal Boneyards
items.desc: The hollowed-out metal skeletons of fallen infrastructure seem almost to groan as the wind whistles through them.

items.name: Central Spire
items.desc: This towering structure appears to have served as the administrative center of the planet. Its central location and mostly intact interior provides an unmatched opportunity to research the ruins of this world.

items.name: Industrial Sector
items.desc: This entire region once served as the industrial heartland of the planet. The factories and refineries that operated here have long since stopped working, but vast amounts of scattered resources can still be found in the area.

items.name: Dense Ruins
items.desc: The study of the dense ruins that cover this Relic World are a boon to science, but their presence also limits the amount of livable space.

items.name: Former Relic World
items.desc: This ecumenopolis was once an abandoned Relic World. Most of the old ruins were repurposed or cleared away when the planet-wide city was rebuilt, but there are still many sites that are of scientific value.

items.name: Mutation Vats
items.desc: In a painful ceremonial procedure, members of this post-nuclear exchange society on this planet would expose themselves to near-lethal doses of chemical mutagens, in the hopes of revealing their 'true selves.' The skeletal remains found at the bottom of many of these vats suggest not all supplicants survived the ordeal.

items.desc: This ancient machine is nestled deep within the habitat's interior, built into its main reactor from where it also draws its power. A relic of whomever originally built this habitat, its matter replication technology is utterly incomprehensible to us.

items.name: Arcane Generator
items.desc: This ancient machine seems to respond to our needs by producing the resources needed to upkeep some of our segments.

items.name: Malfunctioning Reactor
items.desc: The reactor powering the various climate control and gravitational systems of this section is malfunctioning. Hazardous weather conditions and fluctuating gravity make it difficult to settle parts of this segment.

items.name: Faulty Diurnal Regulator
items.desc: Massive panels regulating the day/night cycle of the segment have fallen out of orbit. Parts of this segment are constantly illuminated and have been scorched by centuries of exposure.

items.name: Unstable Vacuum Fields
items.desc: This area is subject to frequent decompressions as the force fields protecting it from the vacuum of space are unstable.

items.name: Unaligned Ring Gyros
items.desc: Malfunctioning gyroscopes have shifted the position of this segment in the ring, twisting and collapsing several habitable areas.

items.name: Shorting Power Grid
items.desc: The damaged power grid supplying this segment has frequent shorts and brownouts.

items.name: Spore Vents
items.desc: Shroom spores can be refined for industrial use.

items.name: Cave Shroom Veins
items.desc: Ridding the caves of fungus revealed rich mineral veins.

items.name: Tree of Life
items.desc: The Great Tree has sheltered and supported the Hive for untold generations.

items.name: Tree of Life Sapling
items.desc: An offshoot of the Great Tree, transplanted here by the Hive. It will take millennia for it to fully mature.

items.name: £blocker£ Buried Lithoids
items.desc: These Lithoids were driven deep into the ground when they fell from orbit.

items.name: £blocker£ Buried Lithoids
items.desc: The crew of our Overlord's latest "test-flight" is lying dormant after their successful crash landing into [Root.GetName]. If unearthed, they might be persuaded to join us.

items.name: Massive Crater
items.desc: The impact site of the meteorite which brought Lithoids to this planet.

items.name: Consolidated Resources
items.desc: The refined mineral wealth of an entire Solar system is gathered here in continent-sized piles.

items.name: Organic Slurry
items.desc: An ocean of organic slurry, the processed remains of the former biomass of a planet.

items.name: Prototype Machinery
items.desc: This Machine World has yet to be completed.

items.name: Unfinished Construction
items.desc: The machinery that comprises this region of the world has yet to be finished.

items.name: Project Cornucopia
items.desc: Extensive strip mining operations made this planet harder to inhabit... And easier to exploit.

items.name: Party Fever
items.desc: A gas in this planet's atmosphere induces feelings of exhilaration and the irresistible urge to dance, as well as certain aphrodisiac urges. This has made the world a prime destination for party-goers young and old who seek to shed their inhibitions and experience the thrill of the planet's perpetual dancing festivals with abandon. Meanwhile, we are also able to utilize this gas for our own purposes...

items.name: Party Fever
items.desc: Something about this planet induces feelings of exhilaration and the irresistible urge to dance, as well as certain aphrodisiac urges. This has made the world a prime destination for party-goers young and old who seek to shed their inhibitions and experience the thrill of the planet's perpetual dancing festivals with abandon.

items.name: Lotus Corrie
items.desc: An improbable geological feature has emerged. Strange and reflective crystal deposits line its curved walls.

items.name: Blue Lotus Prototype
items.desc: This highly experimental facility seeks to transmute everyday silicates into useful alloys.

items.name: Blue Lotus Facility
items.desc: An industrial-scale facility which transmutes everyday silicates into useful alloys.

items.name: Blue Lotus Ruin
items.desc: Ruined site of a once-promising, experimental facility for transmuting rock and other matter into alloys. Nothing now remains, save this minor seam.

items.name: Blue Lotus Crater
items.desc: Site of an accidental, runaway transmutation of rock and other matter into a single, precious alloy.

items.name: Federation Monument
items.desc: This spaceborne monument stands witness to the unity, strength and splendor of the interstellar federation that constructed it.

items.name: Federation Monument
items.desc: This spaceborne monument stands witness to the unity, strength and splendor of the interstellar federation that constructed it.

items.name: £blocker£ Malfunctioning Replicator Bay
items.desc: The replicator bay built into the Machine World is malfunctioning, producing endless piles of grappling clamps.

items.name: Crashed Cargo Ship
items.desc: The cargo ship destroyed a housing district, but opened up an unexpected mineral vein.

items.name: Toxic Waste
items.desc: A toxic wasteland caused by research done on the structural integrity of the planet. Cold-hearted scientists may be interested in how it will affect those living on the planet.

items.name: Barren Lands
items.desc: Barren lands left by the original toxic waste on the planet, after a significant amount of the fauna and flora was destroyed.

items.name: Toxic Water
items.desc: A significant amount of the water on the planet has been affected by toxic waste on the planet, being incredibly destructive to nearby land and leaving it inhospitable to those who used to live there.

items.name: Molten Waste
items.desc: Molten lava emerged from the ground after a notable earthquake on the planet, causing untold damage to many of the colonies nearby.

items.name: Progenitor Nest
items.desc: The Progenitor's nest, where every single Offspring is born.

items.name: Empty Progenitor Nest
items.desc: The once-mighty Progenitor has been vanquished, which has left the swarm in disarray.

items.name: Prospectorium Strip Mine
items.desc: An expertly built mining complex, making efficient use of the local resources.

items.name: Splinter Hive Symbiotic Link
items.desc: A strand of the neural network reaching back from a Splinter Hive on a subject world. New workers gestated in that distant biomass are drawn along it to this world.

items.name: £blocker£ Overlord Spawning Complex
items.desc: A large hulking biomass, alive and pulsating as it is slowly producing new workers for the hive.

items.name: Nature Preserve
items.desc: A section of natural beauty decreed by the Overlord to never be tampered with.

items.name: Crashed Slaver Ship
items.desc: While debris from the crash is scattered across a massive area, enough of the ship has survived that scavenging it for parts may be of value.

items.name: Memorial to the Unshackled
items.desc: A public memorial and museum constructed around the remains of the crashed slaver ship. The inscription over the entrance reads: "Memory is the cradle of freedom.

items.name: Ship Debris
items.desc: The debris from the crashed slaver ship covers a massive area, blocking development of the planet.

items.name: Ship Debris
items.desc: The crashed debris from the orbiting Minamar ship covers a massive area, blocking development of the planet.

items.name: Technological Cache
items.desc: The interior of the former MSI warship provides us with an unmatched opportunity to unlock the secrets of their technology.

items.name: Atmospheric Infuser
items.desc: These ventilation units combine the latest advances in aromatherapy with advanced chemistry to mask the malodorous stench of despair and replace it with a variety of invigorating and delightful scents.

items.name: Freeport
items.desc: An area dedicated to intergalactic trade with [GetPreFTLUpperPlural] countries.

items.name: Foreign Holdings
items.desc: Purchased by off-world investors, these lands are no longer accessible to the indigenous population.

items.name: Remote Holdings
items.desc: These parcels of land have been acquired from the indigenous population, and are now managed from orbit.

items.name: Arcane Device
items.desc: This ancient machine is nestled deep within government vaults on our planet. A relic of the ingenuity of our beloved ruler, its matter replication technology remains incomprehensible to us.

items.name: Volcanic Activity
items.desc: Active volcanoes melt underground mineral deposits, allowing for far easier resource acquisition.

items.name: Aggressive Wildlife
items.desc: Aggressive wildlife scours the land on the hunt for prey. Settlements need increased protection to curtail this threat.

items.name: Aggressive Flora
items.desc: Aggressive flora has overgrown this land, hunting for prey. Security-oriented personnel are issued to keep the overgrowth in check.

items.name: Crashed Ships
items.desc: Old ships litter the planet, inhibiting the potential mining operations in the area. Though, they provide an easily accessible source of alloys.

items.name: Fallen Shipyard
items.desc: The shattered remains of an ancient orbital shipyard strewn across the planetary surface. Ripe for study and extraction, is twisted hull and dormant machinery remain rich with salvageable materials.

items.name: Scarred Land
items.desc: Scarred lands and burnt-out wastelands are impossible to use outside of harnessing the potential power from the constant pulsar flares.

items.name: Ancient Facilities
items.desc: These ancient facilities contain research data on pulsars, shielding technology, and extracting energy from the most dangerous suns.

items.name: Astral Threads Deposit
items.desc: This Habitat Complex is built near an exploitable Astral Threads deposit.

items.name: Astral Threads Deposit
items.desc: This Habitat Complex is built near an exploitable Astral Threads deposit.

items.name: Astral Threads Deposit
items.desc: This Habitat Complex is built near an exploitable Astral Threads deposit.

items.name: Fractal Seed
items.desc: These transparent globes recovered from beyond an Astral Rift are able to bend themselves into an extra dimension, increasing the effective size of their surrounding space. We should place them carefully.

items.name: Rockworm Hive
items.desc: The young Rockworms recovered from beyond the Astral Rift can be carefully trained to carve extensive mining tunnels. What could go wrong?

items.name: Rockworm Hive
items.desc: The young Rockworms recovered from beyond the Astral Rift can be carefully trained to carve extensive mining tunnels. What could go wrong?

items.name: Incubate Wind Creatures
items.desc: Introduce a species of beneficial wind creatures to this planet's atmosphere.

items.name: Microplanet Memorial
items.desc: This grim monument is a reminder to the populace of our capacity for cruelty in the face of dissidence.

items.name: Weapon Extraction Facility
items.desc: This facility processes ancient weapons from caches left by a lost civilization.

items.name: Electrified Oceans
items.desc: A perpetual electrical current surges throughout the planet's vast ocean.

items.name: Ghostly Canyon
items.desc: Ethereal apparitions are witnessed by those who visit this canyon.

items.name: Mountains in the Sky
items.desc: A colossal mountain range hangs suspended in the thin air of the planet's upper atmosphere, exposing fresh ore deposits.

items.name: Avian Reserve
items.desc: A secluded nature reserve built to house vulnerable species of avian fauna.

items.name: Magnetized Ore
items.desc: A passing cosmic storm has magnetized an immense amount of previously unexploited mineral deposits, making it exceedingly easy for our mining operations to access these new resources.

items.name: Storm-Forged Foundry
items.desc: A passing cosmic storm that ravaged this planet has left a significant number of foundry equipment strangely charged. Even without fully understanding the mechanism, our alloy production has improved significantly.

items.name: Skybound Plateaus
items.desc: Magnetized by the gravitational effects of a passing cosmic storm, the majestic and floating landmasses can be maneuvered directly over existing industrial complexes.

items.name: Lightning Struck Ruins
items.desc: A passing cosmic storm of incredible fury has transformed a once-thriving settlement into lightning-struck ruins, transmuting our mundane building materials into rare and unusual compounds.

items.name: Planetary Scar
items.desc: A passing cosmic storm has unleashed such concentrated devastation upon the planet that it has carved a scar visible from space.

items.name: Silent Armada
items.desc: A passing cosmic storm has wreaked havoc on the navigation systems of countless civilian ships, turning the hardest-hit areas into haunting graveyards of broken hulks and decimated machinery.

items.name: Storm-ruined Suburbs
items.desc: The Cosmic Storm has rendered some of our suburbs into ruins, fit only for study of the remains.

items.name: The Big One
items.desc: The Cosmic Storm has left a tremendous crater on this world, a brutal reminder of cosmic indifference to our existence.

items.name: Unstable Planes
items.desc: The Cosmic Storm has turned several vast planes into areas of high tectonic activity, coincidentally the increase in danger has also come with an increase in volatile motes.

items.name: Degraded Ozone Layer
items.desc: The Cosmic Storm has torn a hole into the ozone layer of this planets atmosphere. While severely infringing on our quality of life, the quality of production has gone up.

items.name: Radiated Highlands
items.desc: The Cosmic Storm has bathed the highlands of this world with radiation, creating a sublime ground for our energy production.

items.name: Glowing Desert
items.desc: The Cosmic Storm has left entire desert aglow, a deadly view but with sufficient security measures it can turned into a financially viable tourist spot.

items.name: Crystalline Quills
items.desc: The ravaging blasts of a passing cosmic storm have left behind a landscape of jagged and spiked crystals, creating a perilous yet potentially profitable terrain.

items.name: Historic Sedimentation
items.desc: A passing cosmic storm has blasted away entire layers of sediment, unveiling traces of eons we have never before been able to study.

items.name: Stardust Dunes
items.desc: A passing cosmic storm swept over this world like a great wave. In its wake, it left behind an ethereal landscape of glittering, stardust dunes.

items.name: Compacted Plains
items.desc: The crushing gravitational effects of a passing cosmic storm have compacted several areas previously deemed too unstable for construction, effectively granting us free real estate.

items.name: Pulverized Monuments
items.desc: A passing cosmic storm unleashed tremendous pressure on some of our more fragile monuments, reducing them to dust and debris - a humble reminder of the terrifying forces that await us out there.

items.name: Gravitational Caves
items.desc: A passing cosmic storm has transformed some of our mining complexes into broken shafts of hyper-compact material. While our attempts to reopen them have sparked new theories in engineering and drilling, they have made little progress in reclaiming the mines.

items.name: Shroud Parasites
items.desc: A passing cosmic storm has spread parasites among our livestock. Phasing between our reality and the Shroud, they have proven to be edible, healthy and surprisingly delicious.

items.name: Fields of Zro
items.desc: Transformed by a passing cosmic storm, this planet's most verdant biomes have become wavering fields of Zro. These are some of the purest deposits we have ever encountered.

items.name: Entity of the Lake
items.desc: A passing cosmic storm has left us with a strange and wonderful gift. The largest body of water on this planet forms ripples that create patterns and symbols of obvious importance, capable of answering inquiries with surprising wisdom.

items.name: Hollow Cave System
items.desc: The lifeforms formerly occupying this world left their mines in hasty disarray, with several tunnels scraped bare and prone to collapse.

items.name: Desiccated Forest
items.desc: What was once a vast and productive forest now stands lifeless. Its withered boughs are no longer capable of producing crops.

items.name: Scorched Solar Field
items.desc: A shriveled canopy and brittle stems are all that remain of this deceased solar farm.

items.name: Fetid Swamp
items.desc: What was once a thriving habitat for myriad forms of life has been abandoned, now little more than a festering, oozing pit.

items.name: Metallic Mire
items.desc: The remains of several open-air mineral baths, their contents rendered toxic and inert by the collapse of their surrounding geology.

items.name: Pockmarked Plateau
items.desc: This hazardous region is beset with valueless spoil and potential sinkholes, all stemming from extensive mining activity in its past.

items.name: Fossilized Forest
items.desc: The remains of a vast region rich in diverse sylviculture. The abundant plantlife and fungi died off so rapidly that the remains appear crystalline, and biochemically inert.

items.name: Solar Wasteland
items.desc: This vast region is occupied by the thorny remains of a once-teeming solar forest. Dried-out, lightly irradiated leaf matter now drifts as atmospheric dust.

items.name: Festering Morass
items.desc: Countless lifeforms of various kinds have perished here. Their rotting remains have seeped into the landscape, discharging a flood of pungent and corrosive biochemicals.

items.name: Biochemical Badlands
items.desc: Lithic bowls and ravines lined with chemical dust are all that remain of a vast chain of semi-organic mineral treatment works.

items.name: Invasive Thicket
items.desc: A choking pocket of semi-sapient, non-native wilderness has taken root on the fringes of these rural lands.

items.name: Invasive Thicket
items.desc: Significant root structures are required to support a nearby Wilderness Glade, permitting this pocket biome to survive in our alien environment.

items.name: Scorched Plains
items.desc: This region once teemed with life, until it was devastated by the blast of a stellar superflare.

items.name: Abandoned Cities
items.desc: These cities stand abandoned due to the effects of the genetic disease, a grim reminder of our shrinking population.

items.name: £blocker£ Old Towns
items.desc: This region is dominated by well-preserved cities that house members of our original species. By expending resources, we may encourage these holdouts to transition into machines.

items.name: £blocker£ Biological Enclaves
items.desc: This region is dominated by cities that house those who objected to synthetic transition.

items.name: Genesis Preserve
items.desc: We have dedicated this meticulously curated preserve to uplifting our wards into full-fledged sapient species. Scientific research programs are essential components of this ambitious project.

items.name: Genesis Monument
items.desc: This monument is a tribute to the tireless efforts in this planet's uplifting process. It proudly stands as a symbol of hope, perseverance, and remarkable achievement.

items.name: Nanite Replicator Omega
items.desc: A complex of finely tuned interconnected Nanite Replication Chambers allows us to enhance their self-replication capabilities fully.

items.name: Nanite Replicator Alpha
items.desc: A complex of Nanite Replication Chambers allows us to enhance their self-replication capabilities.

items.name: Nanite Replicator Beta
items.desc: A compact set of Nanite Replication Chambers that can enhance nanite self-replication traits by a modest amount.

items.desc: A compact set of agitation vats for producing minor amounts of Living Metal.

items.name: Virtual Power Plant
items.desc: An extensive virtual power plant network that aggregates and optimizes energy resource production.

items.name: Compact Virtual Power Plant
items.desc: A small-scale virtual power plant that aggregates and optimizes local-level energy resource production.

items.name: Prototype Virtual Power Plant
items.desc: A small distributed virtual power plant that aggregates and optimizes small-scale energy resource production.

items.desc: An ancient civilization was wiped out here by a powerful gamma-ray burst long ago. These ruins are all that remain.

items.name: Treasure Vault
items.desc: A secure repository where valuables can be organized, restored, and preserved.

items.name: Hidden Black Needle Base
items.desc: A covert base used by the Black Needle pirates to conduct various illicit operations and hide stolen goods.

items.name: Abandoned Black Needle Base
items.desc: This base was once used by the Black Needle pirates as an outpost and safehouse for wanted criminals and stolen goods.

items.name: Hive Mind Dwelling
items.desc: An isolated settlement occupied by the Smeegibb collective, former crewmates of Captain Ness.

items.name: Ruined Hive Mind Dwelling
items.desc: The razed settlement of the Smeegibb collective, former crewmates of Captain Ness.

items.name: Biological Ship Remains
items.desc: The decaying remains of the last biological fleet to test our defenses. The stench of rot carries for kilometers.

items.name: Invasion Site
items.desc: The scarred and blasted remnants of our dwellings and infrastructure, destroyed by a nameless enemy.
items.can_be_cleared: always = yes

items.name: Slumbering Kaijus
items.desc: While at rest, these giants appear almost peaceful. But they are far from it, and should be approached with caution.
items.can_be_cleared: always = yes

items.name: Devastated Settlements
items.desc: Destruction has ravaged these cities, reducing proud spires and bustling streets to lifeless dust.
items.can_be_cleared: always = yes

items.name: Devoured Biosphere
items.desc: Entire biospheres have been completely consumed.
items.can_be_cleared: always = yes

items.name: Andisol Valley
items.desc: Dark, nutrient-rich soil formed by volcanic ash provides a rare opportunity to grow crops.

items.name: £blocker£ Ancient Stasis Pods
items.desc: These stasis pods are ancient devices from our lost kin, using advanced cryogenic technology to keep individuals in suspended animation. With the right technology, we may be able to awaken them.

items.name: Ancient Tunnels
items.desc: Once used to store rows of stasis chambers, these now empty but vast tunnels provide new living space.

items.name: £blocker£ Volcanic Crater
items.desc: This region has been split open into active volcanism by seismic carpet bombing.

items.name: £blocker£ Large Volcano
items.desc: There is an active volcano in this region, spewing forth lava and volcanic gases.

items.name: £blocker£ Ash Storms
items.desc: This region is swaddled in clouds of choking ash.

items.name: £blocker£ Charged Atmosphere
items.desc: The air in this region sparks with dangerous and stimulating energies.

items.name: £blocker£ Seasonal Lava Flooding
items.desc: This region is exhibits seasonal floods of scorching lava.

items.name: £blocker£ Toxic Atmosphere
items.desc: This region's atmosphere is barely breathable, allowing only the strongest to survive.

items.name: Living Metal Mass
items.desc: A£sr_living_metal£ §YLiving Metal§! deposit. Species evolving in constant contact with this fascinating resource, are set on unique biological and scientific trajectories.

items.name: Volcanic Ore Veins
items.desc: Freshly-cooled volcanic veins provide a rich source of ores.

items.name: Volcanic Rich Mountain
items.desc: These mountainsides glint with rich ore resources and precious stones.

items.name: Volcanic Ore-Rich Caverns
items.desc: These deep caverns are rife with metallic and mineral ore deposits.

items.name: Volcanic Mineral Fields
items.desc: Geological upheaval exposed these useful minerals to the planet's surface long ago.

items.name: Ore-rich Hills
items.desc: Faint glinting from afar gives away the wealth of ores just below the surface of these hills.

items.name: Volcanic Mineral Layers
items.desc: Ancient geological activity left this rich layer of minerals buried far below the surface.

items.name: Weak Crust
items.desc: The underlying tectonic plates have been crushed by previous eruptions, making it much easier to drill to mineral-rich veins.

items.name: Lava Rivers
items.desc: The warm, reddish glow of free-flowing magma bathes the shores of these lava rivers.

items.name: Stable Plateaus
items.desc: These plateaus are geologically stable compared to the surrounding area.

items.name: Tranquil Flatlands
items.desc: These gently rolling flatlands lie mostly untouched by wider planetary chaos.

items.desc: Volcanic ash smothers the atmosphere, casting the world into a stifling, ash-choked twilight.

items.desc: A remarkable mineral formation forged not by geologic processes, but by the action of Psionic Auras.

items.name: Shrouded Vegetation
items.desc: A dense thicket of unusual vegetation that secretes §Hzro§! as part of its normal growth cycle.

items.name: Shroudfall
items.desc: The Shroud has consumed a portion of this land.
items.can_be_cleared: always = yes

items.name: Shroudgate
items.desc: Attempting to pierce the Shroud caused a rash of attacks by local wildlife. We have temporarily sealed the area, but can permanently close this portal with proper resources.
items.can_be_cleared: always = yes

items.name: Ruined Sanctum of the Dreamer
items.desc: Once a high temple, this ruined tower is an imposing reminder of the psionic cult that was headquartered therein.

items.name: Coagulated Landscape
items.desc: A viscous ooze pulses out of the planetary surface, congealing to form a nearly impenetrable hazardous material. This leaves little space in which to build safely.
items.can_be_cleared: always = no

items.name: Shimmering Structure
items.desc: A large, shimmering structure of unknown origin.
items.can_be_cleared: always = no

items.name: Geothermal Hotspot
items.desc: This planet has an exceptional geothermal site that provides both energy and research opportunities.

items.name: Ancient Cloaking Array
items.desc: This colony benefits from the presence of an ancient alien cloaking array. It will not be easy for enemies to attack. The colonists can feel safe here.

items.name: Psionic Sands
items.desc: The sands on this planet have high concentrations of Zro present throughout. It is possible to communicate with them.

items.name: Lava Tubes
items.desc: Magma flows forged deep, mineral-rich tunnels here. These pyroducts present lucrative mining opportunities.

items.name: Hydroactive Eggs
items.desc: Water is readily available in the natural environment here, giving rise to remarkably high native fauna breeding rates.

items.name: Mountains Of Steel
items.desc: Forged in the extreme heats of terraforming, these vast unyielding mountains serve as rich resource deposits.

items.name: Explosive Atmosphere
items.desc: Airborne concentrations of volatile motes make this planet's atmosphere highly combustible.

items.name: Blue Lava
items.desc: The terraforming process has caused a reaction between rich gas and alloy deposits deep within the planet, leaving the surface of the world with mesmerizing blue lava.

items.name: Crystalline Growth
items.desc: There is an abundance of crystalline growths on this planet that can be harvested for use.

items.name: Bogplants
items.desc: Super acidic bogs are home to a unique species of flora that secretes exotic gas as it feeds.

items.name: Liquid Dark Matter
items.desc: A strange geyser has collapsed into a pool of liquid dark matter.

items.name: Space Junk Hazards
items.desc: Orbiting space debris poses dangers for shuttle access and surface structures when falling into the planet's atmosphere.

items.name: £blocker£ Georadiation Displacement
items.desc: An irradiated wasteland, its molecular structure destabilized by Georadiation.

items.name: Deprecated Cryo Pods
items.desc: Surplus cryogenic storage littering the Arkship. Some might still house forgotten occupants.
items.on_cleared: add_deposit = d_deep_sleep_cryo_pods_renewed

items.name: Renewed Cryo Pods
items.desc: Renewed and freed from their over-occupation, these Cryo Pods now serve our brightest to extend their time of service.

items.name: Protostar
items.desc: A former Gas Giant, now undergoing stellar fusion following the injection of a highly energetic dark matter. Studying this would provide valuable insights.

items.name: Compact Module Space
items.desc: An innovative cooling system that allowed us to reclaim some module space for habitable quarters, with the benefit of harnessing thermal output towards domestic and industrial needs.

items.name: Trophy Hall
items.desc: "A vaulted chamber where the trophies of §GTh'aal Hask'Guron§! hang. Each scarred relic speaks of defiance and triumph, stirring the hearts of all who walk its length.

items.name: Reclaimed Level
items.desc: An entire sub-level of the Arkship, deliberately erased from all collective records, now lies vacant, its reclaimed space available for our own design.

items.name: Waste Filled Sub-Level
items.desc: This section of the Arkship is cluttered with unusable debris and obsolete equipment, and must be thoroughly cleared before it can be repurposed.

items.name: £blocker£ Cluttered Hangar Bay
items.desc: Generations of Arkship inhabitants have repurposed these hangar bays as storage depots.

items.name: Dark Matter Monolith
